name: Evelyn Rose
source:
A former lover from when the protagonist studied abroad. She was the first woman the protagonist had sex with.

She says she doesn't like anything tight, and she prefers not to wear a bra.

She is the kind of woman who asks if you are a virgin within 30 minutes of meeting you.

While she has a good sense of humor, she has a sexy side to her that she doesn't talk about much. 

She doesn't seem to live with her husband, but she is still fond of him.
